name: Do I still need a real estate agent if I sell my home for cash?

mainEntity.name: Do I still need a real estate agent if I sell my home for cash?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can sell to a cash buyer directly, having a real estate professional like Kelby Contreras can still be beneficial. An agent can help you understand the current market value of your property, evaluate the cash offer against other potential options, and navigate the closing process to ensure your interests are protected. This provides first-party insight, as a professional can offer an unbiased assessment and ensure you make an informed decision, even in a direct cash sale.
acceptedAnswer.description: An agent can help evaluate cash offers, understand market value, and protect your interests during a direct sale.
